test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**associated**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Associated**" means connected or linked to something. (किसी चीज़ से जुड़ा हुआ)

 
 
• **For example**: *Smoking is often associated with an increased risk of lung cancer.*
